sloka: कारिताः सर्व एवैते शास्त्रज्ञैः यज्ञकोविदैः ।शोभाअर्थम् तस्य यज्ञस्य कांचन अलंकृत अभवन् ॥१-१४-२४॥
transliteration: kāritāḥ sarva evaite śāstrajñaiḥ yajñakovidaiḥ ।śobhāartham tasya yajñasya kāṁcana alaṁkṛta abhavan ॥1-14-24॥

translations.english: All those posts, strong with eight sides and finely finished surfaces, wellcarved by sculptors were duly erected.
